pythonFunction.name: get_wna_amount
pythonFunction.description:
Returns the weather normalization adjustment amount and direction (surcharge or credit). Applies
only to an account that carries a weather normalization amount (a Washington Gas Virginia mechanism). Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, applies and, when it applies, wna_amount and wna_direction.
